title: egress-policy-broker-terraform-module
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a reusable Terraform module (egress-policy-broker) that centralizes VPC egress controls across Redwood Private deployments. The module will provide: role-based security group templates, templated NACL snippets, private DNS forwarding zones, and a pluggable egress policy engine that can emit Terraform-managed transient rules for canary/burst scenarios. This ticket covers design, core implementation, upgrade path from existing modules, automated health checks, and CI gating for security review.
acceptance_criteria: Module published to internal registry with semantic versioning and docs
Security group and NACL templates deployable via a single module instance per VPC
Private DNS forwarding zone created and validated with resolvability checks
Egress policy engine supports tag-based rule generation and rollback
Automated health checks (Terraform plan + runtime probes) fail CI on drift or unhealthy egress behavior
Upgrade guide provided for existing stacks using legacy-egress-* modules
Module passes security review and automated IAM least-privilege linting
implementation_plan: Create initial module scaffold with inputs/outputs and examples
Implement SG templates with input-driven allow/deny sets and tag selectors
Add NACL template support for subnet-level policies and default deny option
Integrate private DNS forwarding (route53/privatezones or cloud-equivalent) with test records
Build egress-policy-broker submodule to translate high-level policies into SG/NACL actions
Add lifetime and canary flags to allow transient rules and automatic rollback
Author Terraform upgrade notes and automated migration script for existing stateful resources
Create CI pipeline: terraform fmt/validate/plan, policy checks (opa/conftest), and post-apply health probes
Run cross-team review and iterate on IAM permissions and audit logging
notes_and_decisions: 2026-01-22 - Design review: selected tag-based approach over CIDR lists to reduce churn and support multi-tenant overlays (decision by: Priya Nambiar)
2026-01-29 - Chose to keep NACLs as opt-in because default-deny at NACL level caused frequent app outages in pilot clusters (note by: Miguel Ortega)
2026-02-12 - Adopt semantic versioning v1.0.0 for first GA module release; breaking changes require major bump
2026-02-19 - Security: IAM role for module will be scoped to modify SG/NACL/Route53 resources only; KMS key permissions only if private-dns encrypted (review requested)
2026-02-25 - Health checks to include: TCP probe to known egress endpoint, DNS resolution of private forward records, and Terraform state drift detection
2026-03-03 - Tradeoff: implementing full policy language deferred to future ticket; current scope supports JSON policy objects mapped to tags and rule templates
2026-03-09 - Decided to emit detailed telemetry (CloudWatch/Datadog) for egress rule changes for auditability and incident triage
